read.en: SPCX edged up 0.1% on Nov 12 to $139.94, trading $137.75–147.58. It is above the rising 5-day ($139.8) and the 10-day ($137.1) and below the 100-day ($142.7) and 30-day ($148.8), both falling (no 200-day yet, 107 sessions). MACD crossed above its signal on Nov 12, below zero; Parabolic SAR has been bullish since Nov 11 ($120.89), and RSI is 46.9.
read.zh: SPCX 11月12日微涨 0.1%，收于 $139.94，盘中区间 $137.75–147.58。股价位于上行的 5 日均线（$139.8）和 10 日均线（$137.1）上方，100 日（$142.7）和 30 日均线（$148.8）下方，二者均在下行（上市仅 107 个交易日，尚无 200 日均线）。MACD 于 11月12日上穿信号线，在零轴下方；抛物线 SAR 自 11月11日起看多（$120.89），RSI 为 46.9。

read.en: The $147.58 high cleared the $144.9–145.2 Nov 10–11 highs intraday but faded, and the close stayed under the 100-day and the $140.66 Oct 15 low. Resistance is $140.7–143.2, then $144.9–147.6 and $148.8–149.8 (30-day, Aug 17 high). Support is $137.1–139.8 (5 and 10-day, Nov 12 low), then $134.3–135.4 and $130.2–131.9. A close above $143.2 would target $145–147.6; below $137.1, $134–135.
